scope.rule: A listing or lineup alone is announced evidence, not proof of performance. Records below use post-event coverage, an official post-event video, or a clearly marked weaker concert log. Pakistani exceptions were assessed under the user's stated international-performance exception.
scope.local_data_note: The retained 2026-08-19 and 2026-08-21 snapshots and shows ledger were searched read-only. Their matches are listings/ledger signals only and were not used as performance proof. Zero local matches does not mean an artist had no shows.

structural_flags: 462 records have no entity_type; this aligns with the legacy-candidate population and needs identity/entity review before promotion.

No exact normalized-name duplicate was found by a punctuation/space-insensitive full-roster scan, but semantic near-duplicates remain: anuv-jain / anuv-jain-live and the noncanonical paradox-punch versus the separate rapper Paradox evidence below.
The audit only identifies review risk. It does not conclude that any unresearched artist has not performed recently.
